findings.finding: A reconciled terminal receipt remained embedded in state and was inherited by later lifecycle transitions. That blocked the next terminal write and could append the old terminal result against a later intermediate post-state after a crash.
findings.required_remediation: Bind the receipt to the exact terminal post-state without the receipt, reject phase/post drift before audit append, and atomically consume the receipt from durable state after exactly-one audit reconciliation so later transitions cannot inherit it.
